title: Minimum Cost to Move Chips
description: There are chips at positions given by `position`. Moving a chip by two positions costs 0; moving it by one position costs 1. Choose a common final position for all chips and return the minimum total cost. Input: `position`. Output: the minimum cost.
hints: Sort once or track a compact running state to avoid checking every possible group.
Test duplicates, extreme ordering, and cases with no feasible candidate.
